scenario.organization_context: Global tech consulting firm, 1200 employees. IT department uses Okta for SSO.

simulation.subject: URGENT: Your password expires today! Update Now
simulation.body:
Dear User,

Your network password is going to expire in 2 hours. If you do not update your password right now, your account will be locked and you will lose access to all IT systems!

Please click here immediately to reset your password:
[SIMULATED LINK: Reset Password Portal]

Thank you,
IT Help Desk

metadata.difficulty_rationale: Difficulty 1 is achieved through multiple glaring red flags including extreme urgency, a generic greeting, and an implausible sender address.
metadata.scenario_notes: Designed for basic awareness training targeting IT staff with obvious anomalies.

semantic_findings: The target role is IT, yet the email uses a generic 'Dear User' greeting and basic IT help desk language instead of referencing specific internal IT support channels or Okta SSO terminology mentioned in the organization context.
The sender domain 'admin-update-sim-training.test' is overly transparent for a simulation targeting IT professionals, who would immediately recognize the domain naming convention as synthetic.
